_comment: Boundaries in core.agent_state / audit.outcome_events where the EISV instrument changed.
Rows stamped with state_json.eisv_instrument (from 2026-10-16) partition on the stamp; this file covers unstamped history and names the current era.

kind: 'value' changes persisted values (directly or through the feedback loops: the action feeds behavioral E via decision_e, and behavioral observations are partly built from ODE state, so a policy- or ODE-only change still moves behavioral E/I/V on later check-ins); 'population' changes which callers produce rows; 'label_only' adds or renames a field with values unchanged.

effective_at_basis: deploy_restart | deploy_reflog | epoch_row | first_seen (earliest row carrying a new key) | merge (deploy time unknown; live at or after this) | file_mtime | approximate. ambiguous_from / ambiguous_until bound the interval in which the change may have gone live; rows inside it belong to neither side.
affects: field families, for reading only. Pooling decisions use kind, not affects, because of the feedback loops above.
A PR that changes the maths appends an entry; tests/test_eisv_instrument_eras.py requires one whenever the golden trajectories change. Its effective_at may stay null: stamped rows do not need it.

eras.summary: Data-lifecycle epoch 1 begins; everything earlier is pre-epoch.
Behavioral verdict wired in; ODE state data declared incompatible (epoch row backfilled 2026-04-20).
Behavioral E/I/S/V promoted to primary, ODE demoted; coherence still computed from ODE V. ambiguous_until is the first row carrying behavioral_eisv.
Tactical calibration truth channel broadened (task_* outcomes).
Behavioral V becomes a single EMA of raw imbalance, with reseed.
Stage A: Phi demoted to telemetry and the S setpoint switched on (A.2 Phi detrend shares the flag). Flag flip time not recorded; live by the #1133 merge.
Risk-path decoupling; adds the Phi fast-trip.
Per-class anchors recalibrated; resident anchors moved to the deployment overlay.
raw_obs persisted.
Tactical calibration channel purity.
tool_usage starts recording MCP transports (REST-only before); sensor_eisv_source persisted from here, so earlier rows cannot be split by instrument class.
Calibration stops training on scraped confidences.
Class-calibration overlay gives residents a non-zero sigma. Overlay file mtime; plist edit time not recorded.
Pause sub-actions score 0 (was a neutral 0.5) in decision_e.
eisv_telemetry persisted; ODE E/I/S/V exist in rows only from here.
coherence_form label added; coherence value unchanged.
Non-authored cold-start guard.
Legacy C(V) removed from auto-outcome quality and ground-truth substitution; check-in action unchanged.
Per-agent confidence offset stable across restarts (reseeded each restart before).
Resolved risk persisted and restored; Phi risk becomes telemetry for recovery and resume.
Cold-start Phi risk never hard-pauses authored rows.
Strict identity on by default; changes which callers produce rows.
Basin reads S minus sigma; one sigma resolver; no Phi fast-trip under behavioral authority. ambiguous_from is the stop-rule instrument_change_at.
ODE E and I read S minus sigma; seed S plus sigma; regime fallback detrended. Restored monitors relax over about 10-15 minutes of check-ins.

Each ODE update is divided into deterministic substeps from a box-wide Jacobian row-sum bound (h*L <= 1 for frozen-input slopes), removing the step amplification at the soft barriers. Golden: 378 numeric leaves change, at most 1.0e-5 (phi); no categorical change. Rows written after it deploys carry era RK1 in state_json.eisv_instrument; record effective_at from the deploy restart.
